assist.title: Edit with AI
assist.editedNote: Edited as requested. Save to apply.
assist.noAi: No AI connection is available. Check your connections in Settings.
assist.notConnectedPc: Not connected to your PC. Connect to your PC first.
assist.parseFailed: Could not read a prompt from the AI response. Try rewording your request.
assist.defaultTitle: Uses the default connection from Settings
assist.viaPcTitle: Edits with your PC's remote settings (agent, model, effort)
assist.placeholder: Describe how to change it. Leave empty to polish it overall. e.g. Add a three-line key summary at the end of answers
assist.running: The AI is editing… it fills in the box below as it goes.

concise.label: More concise
concise.text: Keep the meaning and rules, but make the sentences shorter and more concise.

plain.label: Plain words
plain.text: Replace difficult wording with plain words. Keep the rules and formats.

example.label: Add an example
example.text: Add one example of a good answer the model can follow.

format.label: Tidy format
format.text: Organize the instructions into a numbered list so they are easy to read. Do not change the output format rules.

liveNote: Changed prompts apply from your next question. Answers you already received stay the same.
pcNote: Chats run on the PC and follow the prompts in the PC app. You can change prompts in the PC app.
placeholder: Leave empty and save to use the default text.

reset.message: Reset “{label}” to the app’s default text. Your edits will be removed.
reset.title: Reset to default?

title: Manage prompts
